indexConvention: Original frozen r02e exported body POSITION rows and triangle index rows; no mesh processing, welding or reindexing before inspection. One body glTF primitive verified.
coordinateConvention: Apply glTF scene transform, then convert (x,-z,y) to Blender world.
headSelection: Connected component of vertices with Z>.30 nearest (-.06,-.72,.45). Other high-Z components excluded by connectivity. This is a geometric selection, not anatomical segmentation.

connectionsToNeck.method: Maximum bottleneck Y along existing head mesh edges to neck vertex 79121. For vertices with Y>cut, each tip is disconnected from this neck anchor at cut equal to the reported threshold, and connected just below it. This is a discrete graph connection saddle, not an anatomical attachment contour or a surface edit.

limits: The head is still part of the full connected body; the Z>.30 boundary is an inspection cut, not an exported edit.
Posterior branch counts depend on the Y threshold. A separate numerical branch does not establish horn/ear identity or the intended design.

Plane path records are the closed paths exposed by trimesh.section.discrete. Open neck-truncated paths are not included: at Y=-.58 there are five closed section loops and six posterior graph components because the lower component continues into the neck cut.
No geometry, edited mesh, or vertex target proposal is produced.
No full-model self-intersection or artistic evaluation is performed.
